hypothesis: Cross-harness provenance and recovery reduce operator uncertainty without turning transcripts into a new authority or side-effect replay engine.
baseline_candidates: Native harness exports plus compressed files/search
Local structured archive with SQLite FTS
scenario: Archive long interrupted and branched sessions from several harnesses, including duplicate journals, malformed records and missing tool receipts. Search for the actual approval that authorized one action, show the sequence, export it and restore in a clean installation. Introduce a parser upgrade and compare fidelity.
failure_cases: Replay executes an old tool command
Redacted secret remains in search index
metrics: Lossless raw preservation and parse coverage
Time to locate an actual scoped approval
